english.title: Aggravated vehicle taking - ( driver did not take ) death caused by accident
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing that a mechanically propelled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), had been taken without the consent of the owner or other lawful authority drove the said vehicle, and after the vehicle was unlawfully taken and before it was recovered, owing to the driving of the vehicle, an accident occurred by which the death of **(..SPECIFY PERSON(S)..) was caused.

(A)_[There were no other aggravating factors]_
(B)_[Additional aggravating factors were **(..SPECIFY FACTORS..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12A of the Theft Act 1968.

english.notes:
This offence wording is now OBSOLETE as a result of the increase in penalty by section 285(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003. now see H6004.

(i) This wording is for use ONLY were the defendant was a 'SUBSEQUENT DRIVER' - for the 'initial taker' see H4382 and 'being carried on' see H4388.
(ii) See also H4392, H4386, H4387, H4483, H4484 and H4485 for other aggravated vehicle taking wordings relating to a 'subsequent driver'.
(iii) More than one injured person may be named.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment.

Obligatory disqualification and endorsement.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three to eleven penalty points - only if special reasons apply.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
